source: ROBOTIS LDS-01 (HLS-LFCD2) specifications, TurtleBot3 e-Manual: detection distance 120 to 3500 mm, accuracy +-15 mm from 120 to 499 mm and +-5.0 percent from 500 to 3500 mm, angular resolution 1 degree, scan rate 5 Hz (300 rpm). The accuracy figures are treated as one standard deviation of Gaussian noise (our assumption, conservative).
